blendstrip.title: Five bands of light — Blend only checked bands halfway toward kept light
blendstrip.message: checked exposure blends include kept zero and leave the successive mask and memory unchanged

copy.strip-mask-blend: Halfway to kept light in checked bands
copy.strip-mask-blend-help: Average current and kept light only in checked bands, including zero. Other bands, the kept strip and the successive mask stay put. This edits the toy, not a real print. Undo restores the whole press.

reversestrip.title: Five bands of light — Reverse the light amounts without reversing the mask
reversestrip.message: reversing five light amounts keeps targets checks and successive mask fixed in one Undo

copy.strip-reverse-light-help: Exchange the outer light amounts, then the next pair; the middle stays put. Targets, checks and the successive mask do not turn. This edits the timing toy, not exposed paper. Undo restores the whole strip.
